name: PKS 2201+044 (Webb)
blurb: PKS 2201+044, an elliptical galaxy with an active nucleus and a jet, seen by Webb.
label: 4c0477-webb
story: In the core of this nearby elliptical galaxy, an active nucleus launches a jet whose visible glow was discovered by Hubble. Webb revisited it as one of a legacy set of nearby optical jets, to help track how the jet's plasma moves.

claims.text: 4C +04.77 is the common name of the source 2201+044 (J2204+0440) at 22h4m17.652s, +4d40'2.023"
Webb program 9226 target 4C04.77 is an active galactic nucleus with a jet
PKS 2201+044 is a nearby BL Lac object hosted in a prominent elliptical galaxy
Hubble discovered the optical counterpart of its radio jet
Webb program 9226 observes a legacy sample of 12 nearby optical jets to track plasma motion
